tagline: Bid in secret. Take the crate. Pay the tariff.

rules.title: How it works
rules.stashAndCrate: Everyone starts with 10 bananas, and 10 more wait in the crate.
rules.secretNumber: Each round, everybody secretly writes a number between 1 and a bananillion.
rules.highestWins: The highest number takes the whole crate, but has to pay a tariff.
rules.tariff: The tariff is their number minus the second highest number, and it goes to whoever wrote it.
rules.bust: Anyone who cannot pay the tariff busts: their bananas drop to zero, and the next player takes their turn at it.
rules.tie: Two equal numbers at the top split the crate and pay no tariff.
rules.crateRefill: At the end of the round the crate refills to match the largest stash on the table.
rules.winning: First to {{score}} bananas wins the game.
rules.comeback: Nobody is knocked out at zero: a bid is not paid up front, so anybody can climb back.
